build_multiwoz_v20_data: build the multiwoz_v20 dataset by downloading MULTIWOZ2.zip to the ParlAI datapath directory
run_build_function: run the build function to download and set up the MultiWOZ 2.0 dialogue dataset
download_multiwoz_resources: download the MultiWOZ 2.0 dataset resource file from the Cambridge repository
check_build_status: check if the multiwoz_v20 dataset has already been built using build_data.built
review_build_function: review the build function that downloads and marks the multiwoz_v20 dataset as complete
